# redis-valkey

Command danger classes (KEYS, FLUSHALL, blocking SAVE), TTL policy and keyspace hygiene the data-access adapter measures.

## Rules

| Rule | Severity | Title |
|---|---|---|
| `AF-DATA-001` | high | KEYS command scans the whole keyspace |
| `AF-DATA-002` | medium | Write without a visible TTL |
| `AF-DATA-003` | critical | FLUSHALL drops every database |
| `AF-DATA-004` | high | FLUSHDB drops the current database |
| `AF-DATA-005` | high | CONFIG rewrites server behavior at runtime |
| `AF-DATA-006` | high | DEBUG is an unsafe introspection command |
| `AF-DATA-007` | medium | MONITOR streams every command |
| `AF-DATA-008` | high | SAVE blocks the server synchronously |
